game: DAL @ LV Week 11 2025, kickoff 2025-11-17 20:15 ET, Allegiant dome

script.base: Closing line is LV +3.5, total 48.5, implied DAL 26.0 / LV 22.5 in a dome. Market expects a competitive game, Dallas up by a field goal to a touchdown late, not a blowout. Williams keeps the lead-back share near his recent 16 carries, but LV's 3.96 YPC run defense caps efficiency. Geno stays in it, so Bowers keeps a 5-6 target intermediate role. Normal dome volume, not a slog and not a 35-point shootout as the base.
script.flip1: Dallas jumps ahead early and runs the clock. Williams' carries spike toward 20-plus and the rush under dies if a chunk run stacks on that volume; Lamb and Pickens yards stall. LV abandons the run and throws, which helps Bowers' targets.
script.flip2: Shootout, or LV hangs around and leads. Both pass games stay live, Williams' carries fall (helps the under), and Bowers/Tucker targets rise. That flip hits the two chosen legs together.

edge_players.edge_sentence: Williams stays under 83.5 rushing yards because he is running into a Las Vegas front that allows 3.96 yards per carry, and even a favorite's bump from his recent 16 carries does not reach 83.5 unless he repeats the 116-yard spike.
edge_players.must_be_true: Williams remains the lead back on a full snap share, LV's run defense plays to its 3.96 YPC / 23 explosive-run profile, and the game stays inside the 26-22.5 script so he does not get 20-plus grind carries plus a breakaway.
edge_players.kills_it: Dallas leads big early, Williams gets 20-plus carries, and one chunk run turns it into another 100-yard day like the 116 in this three-game window. A Cornelius scratch is not required for the under, but if he plays and the line is full strength the efficiency cap is the whole bet.

data_check.notes: No sims and no Pinnacle/Circa/BetOnline prices in the pack, so step 8 cannot compare a projection to a no-vig fair. Williams under: last4 and the 3.96 YPC matchup agree with the strong read; projected 16 carries at even 4.5 YPC is about 72, under 83.5. model_p 0.58 is a pack heuristic, not a sim, and is kept under 70% on purpose. Bowers over: L3 yards agree, last4 is 2-2, so this stays a lean and is not cut. Jeanty rushyds over 60.5 was the other run-game idea (DAL allows 5.12 YPC and 39 runs of 10+, Jeanty 38 carries in the L3) but his own form disagrees (123 yards, 3.24 YPC, last4 75/21/42/60, only one clear over). That was a lean with disagreeing data, so it is dropped, not flagged. Lamb under 110.5 and Pickens over 78.5 were considered and passed: Lamb's air yards (352 in three games) make a median-fade a variance trap, and Pickens is only about a yard above 78.5 against a pass defense that is not bleeding.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and both lost. Williams under lost because Dallas grabbed an early lead, Blue never cut into the carry share, and Williams turned 20 carries plus one 25-yard run into the 116-yard version of himself — the 83.5 median already includes those spikes, and a favorite in a dome can grind. Bowers over lost because Mayer's 13 targets and Jeanty's checkdowns soaked the blitz answers, the 11.52 middle YPA was only 44 attempts of noise, and Bowers posted another 31-38 yard game like two of his last four, with the 127 left behind as a one-week spike. Hooker played and the safeties took the seams. Cornelius was active, so the Dallas line was not short-handed. The counter-case is real on both, which is why Bowers is a lean and Williams is not sized like a 70% leg.
slip_story: One story only: competitive dome game in the mid-20s, not a blowout. Fade the Dallas lead back's efficiency into the LV run front (Williams rushyds under) and play the Raiders' intermediate TE into Dallas' middle leak and 30% blitz (Bowers recyds over). Both survive the base script and the shootout flip. Do not add Lamb or Pickens overs, a Jeanty rush over, or a total over — those need a different explosion or a form profile this read already rejected. No TDs. Two legs. No bet is placed; prices were never shown.
